# Risk Factor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RiskFactor`](gmeow-RiskFactor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RiskFactor>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

The umbrella category of things a mitigation can be set against — causal links (a bowtie barrier on the chain) and hazards (a control at the source). Exists as a NAMED class so [`gmeow:mitigationCounters`](../properties/gmeow-mitigationCounters.md) carries a generator-visible range instead of an anonymous union (the [`IntentionalMoment`](gmeow-IntentionalMoment.md) precedent) and so the relator-arity gate can see the mediation end. Never instantiated directly.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

Use [`gmeow:RiskFactor`](gmeow-RiskFactor.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
